recon.notes: Platform is iMIS Cloud (ASI/Telerik .aspx, tenant COSRH — this org is the rebranded FSRH). The /Public/Events list is rendered client-side by an iMIS iPart, so Playwright is required; raw curl returns only header/footer. 10 upcoming dated events visible (Sep–Dec 2026), mix of conferences (CoSRH Conference 2026 Manchester, Trainer Conference, Scotland women's health) and courses/webinars (Menopause Care course, DCSRH assessments, Postpartum Contraception Training). Details live on per-event pages at /Public/Event_Display.aspx?EventKey=XXXX. The REST endpoint /api/Event exists but returns 401 anonymously (iMIS token auth would be needed). Diploma/Letters of Competence (IUT/SDI) are qualifications, not listed as dated events. Type filter dropdown exists; no pagination observed with 10 items.

recon.notes: Drupal site fully behind an aggressive Cloudflare interactive challenge: curl, WebFetch and even headless Chromium all get 'Just a moment' 403; only HEADED Chromium (headless=False, --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, ~10-30s wait) passed, so GitHub Actions scraping will need a stealth/solver approach. Real listing is /events (NOT /eventslisting, which renders nav only) — server-rendered dated cards (e.g. '17 August 2026 | 8:00am-17:00pm'), 9 events on page 0 with ?page=1 pager, filters for Date/Location/Category (many items flagged 'External Event'), detail pages at /events/[slug]. Saw FFICM/FCICM exam-prep courses and ultrasound (FAMUS/FUSIC, echo) events; no ICM Annual Meeting visible on page 1.
